title: Ansible Variables
description: Schema for host_vars, group_vars, and role defaults in this inventory. Provides hover documentation for all project variables. Variable names are camelCase per the Playbook Layering spec.

hostOperatingSystem.description: Declared OS family of the target host. Roles validate this against ansible_facts.os_family before dispatching. Darwin = macOS; Debian = the Debian/Ubuntu/Raspbian family.

hostArchitecture.description: Declared canonical CPU architecture of the target host. Roles validate this against ansible_facts.architecture, normalizing macOS 'arm64' to 'aarch64'. x86_64 = 64-bit Intel/AMD; aarch64 = 64-bit ARM/Apple Silicon; armv7l = 32-bit ARM; i386 = 32-bit Intel.

env.description: Environment label for the host's inventory (e.g. production, staging, molecule).

onePasswordVault.description: 1Password vault name loaded from the controller's repository-root vars/defaults.yml.

onePasswordTailscaleAPIKey.description: 1Password Tailscale auth-key item name loaded from the controller's repository-root vars/defaults.yml.

tailscaleEnable.description: Set true to enable Tailscale for this host.

tailscaleDomain.description: Tailscale tailnet domain suffix. Combined with tailscaleHostname to form the FQDN used for SSH connectivity.

tailscaleHostname.description: Per-host Tailscale machine name. Combined with tailscaleDomain to form the SSH target FQDN.

tailscaleVersion.description: Optional Tailscale version 1.36.0 or newer for a Debian-family Linux update. Omit for latest; pinned versions are unsupported on macOS.

sambaUsername.description: SMB/Unix account name the samba role provisions. Global default in vars/defaults.yml (empty), overridden per variable at run time (-e sambaUsername=...) or per host/group in a downstream inventory. Varies by machine.

sambaPasswordOpItem.description: 1Password item name (within onePasswordVault) whose 'password' field holds the Samba password. Resolved on the controller at run time via scripts/with-op. Global default in vars/defaults.yml (empty), overridden per variable or per host/group in a downstream inventory. Varies by machine.

sambaPassword.description: Direct Samba password, resolved at run time and never persisted. Pass via -e to set a password without 1Password; when unset the password is read from 1Password via sambaPasswordOpItem.

vscodeExtensions.description: VS Code extension IDs the vscode role installs (e.g. redhat.vscode-yaml). An empty list installs none.

exampleMarkerPath.description: Filesystem path of the marker file written by the example role.
